import os
import subprocess
import sys

from sase.vcs_provider import get_vcs_provider

checkout_target = {{ setup.checkout_target | tojson }}
project_name = {{ setup.project_name | tojson }}
gh_ref = {{ gh_ref | tojson }}

provider = get_vcs_provider(os.getcwd())

# Checkout the PR branch so that subsequent diffs are relative to the
# PR tip rather than the default branch. Try checkout_target first
# (works for default-branch refs like origin/main), then fall back to
# Patch name -> branch name conversion.
is_patch = checkout_target == f"origin/{gh_ref}"
ok, err = provider.checkout(checkout_target, os.getcwd())
if not ok:
    if is_patch:
        # Patch ref — resolve name to branch name
        resolved = provider.resolve_revision(
            gh_ref, project_name, os.getcwd()
        )
        ok, err = provider.checkout(resolved, os.getcwd())
    else:
        # Project/repo ref — try common default branch names
        for fallback in ["master", "main"]:
            ok, err = provider.checkout(fallback, os.getcwd())
            if ok:
                break
    if not ok:
        print(
            f"Warning: checkout failed: {err}",
            file=sys.stderr,
        )

# Sync with remote after checkout
subprocess.run(
    ["git", "pull", "--rebase", "--quiet"],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
    check=False,
)

# Record HEAD for the diff step
result = subprocess.run(
    ["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
    check=False,
)
head = result.stdout.strip() if result.returncode == 0 else ""
print(f"head_before={head}")
print("success=true")

head_before="{{ checkout.head_before }}"
if [ -z "$head_before" ]; then
  exit 0
fi
head_now=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
diff_dir="${SASE_TMPDIR:-${SASE_HOME:-$HOME/.sase}/tmp}/gh-diffs"
mkdir -p "$diff_dir"
diff_file=$(mktemp "$diff_dir/sase-gh-XXXXXX.diff")
if [ "$head_now" != "$head_before" ]; then
  # Commits were made — show only the last commit's diff
  git diff HEAD~1 HEAD > "$diff_file" 2>/dev/null
  commit_msg=$(git log -1 --format='%s' HEAD)
  echo "meta_commit_message=$commit_msg"
else
  # No commits — show uncommitted changes
  git diff HEAD > "$diff_file" 2>/dev/null
  git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -z 2>/dev/null \
    | while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do
        git diff --no-index /dev/null "$f" 2>/dev/null
      done >> "$diff_file"
fi
if [ -s "$diff_file" ]; then
  echo "diff_path=$diff_file"
else
  rm -f "$diff_file"
fi

# Stash any uncommitted changes (including untracked files)
if ! git diff --quiet HEAD 2>/dev/null || [ -n "$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard)" ]; then
  git stash push --include-untracked -m "gh-workflow-$(date +%s)" --quiet
  echo "stashed=true"
else
  echo "stashed=false"
fi
git fetch origin --quiet 2>&1 || true
git pull --rebase --quiet 2>/dev/null || true
echo "success=true"

from sase_github.scripts.gh_setup import main
main(
    gh_ref={{ gh_ref | tojson }},
    n={{ n | tojson }},
    release={{ release | tojson }},
    workflow_label={{ workflow_label | tojson }},
)

output._raw: # Architectural Research & Design Report: Google Calendar Event Description Sub-bullets in `bob gcal sync` **Researcher:** `research.gem` **Report File:** [`gcal_event_description_subbullets__gem.md`](file:///home/bryan/.local/state/sase/workspaces/bobs-org/bob-cli/bob-cli_23/sase/repos/research/202611/gcal_event_description_subbullets__gem.md) **Registered Artifact:** `research:202611/gcal_event_description_subbullets__gem.md` (`explicit:df618bc0af9db5702db4e0dc`) --- ### Executive Summary & Verdict Converting Google Calendar event descriptions into sub-bullets under Event Tasks is a **compelling, high-utility feature** that transforms the daily note's `## Events` section into a true self-contained command center. It gives you immediate access to meeting agendas, discussion topics, and pre-reading materials during your morning GTD review and throughout the day without forcing context-switches back into the browser or calendar app. However, **a naive implementation would be disastrous**. In the wild, over 80% of calendar event descriptions contain massive auto-generated video conferencing footers (Zoom/Teams/Meet dial-in telephone directories, meeting IDs, and legal disclaimers) or raw HTML markup. Without strict sanitization, your daily note would be flooded with telephone numbers, hyperlinks would be stripped into useless plain text, and checklist items could leak into Obsidian Dataview as phantom GTD tasks. --- ### Core Critique: Pitfalls & Risks 1. **The "Dial-In Directory" Noise Hazard:** Video conferencing footers (Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams) often append 15–30 lines of phone numbers and disclaimers. Because `bob` already renders a dedicated camera badge `[📹](url)` on the task line, copying conferencing text into sub-bullets is pure visual clutter. 2. **HTML Hyperlink Destruction:** Google Calendar serializes rich text as HTML. Naively stripping HTML tags removes `` URLs, permanently severing links to Google Docs, Notion specs, and PRs. 3. **Checkbox Contamination (`- [ ]` vs `- `):** Google Calendar rich text supports checklists. Rendering these as `- [ ]` in Obsidian causes Dataview, global task counters, and GTD review walks to treat them as active personal tasks rather than reference material. 4. **Collision with Vault Ownership (Decision 9):** **Decision 9 (`bob-gcal-is-read-only-and-proposes-once`)** guarantees that *the vault owns children and meeting notes*. If sync attempts to mutate child bullets after initial creation, it risks overwriting notes you take during the meeting. --- ### Key Requirement Adjustments To ensure this feature is **intuitive, reliable, and beautiful**, the following adjustments are specified: 1. **Structural Housing via Task Drawer (`- AGENDA`):** Rather than uncontained flat bullets that mix with your live meeting notes, encapsulate the converted description in a native Bob Task Drawer (`- AGENDA`). - **Obsidian Foldability:** You can collapse the agenda into a single line (`- AGENDA ...`) by clicking its fold triangle, keeping `## Events` visually compact while preserving the agenda on demand. - **Clear Boundary:** Clearly separates organizer context from your own live meeting notes (`- NOTES` or direct task notes). - **Capture Integration:** Seamlessly integrates with Bob Mac Capture drawer addressing (`@today+arch-rev#agenda`). 2. **Aggressive Conferencing Boilerplate Suppression:** Detect and discard video conferencing join blocks, dial-in numbers, and email disclaimers. 3. **Rich HTML-to-Markdown Link Preservation:** Convert `TEXT` into `[TEXT](URL)` so linked documents remain functional in Obsidian. Convert basic formatting (``, ``, ``) to Markdown equivalents. 4. **Strict Checkbox Neutralization:** Convert all description checklist items into plain list bullets (`- `), never `- [ ]`. 5. **Length Bounds & Truncation Safeguard:** Cap at 10 lines of bullets. If truncated, append an ellipsis link: `- ... [more in Google Calendar](url)`. 6. **Strict Creation-Only Lifecycle (Write-at-Birth):** Sub-bullets are generated **only** when an Event Task is created (or when a context row is upgraded to a task). On subsequent syncs, the child block is completely ignored by sync, guaranteeing zero churn and zero risk of overwriting your notes. --- ### Recommended Output Geometry When an event is synced, it will render cleanly as: ```markdown - [ ] #task **1000-1100** Architecture Review [📅](https://...) [📹](https://...) [root:: eng] [type:: MEET] ^arch-rev - AGENDA - Review RFC 42: [RFC 42 Spec](https://github.com/...) - Discuss database migration timeline - Open questions from Kelly on API stability ``` If you add meeting notes during or after the call, your daily note cleanly organizes both: ```markdown - [ ] #task **1000-1100** Architecture Review [📅](https://...) [📹](https://...) [root:: eng] [type:: MEET] ^arch-rev - AGENDA - Review RFC 42: [RFC 42 Spec](https://github.com/...) - Discuss database migration timeline - Approved Sunday 02:00 UTC migration window with Ops - Action: submit change ticket to security team ``` --- ### Artifact Registration & File Details - **Report Path:** `/home/bryan/.local/state/sase/workspaces/bobs-org/bob-cli/bob-cli_23/sase/repos/research/202611/gcal_event_description_subbullets__gem.md` - **Durable Snapshot Label:** `research:202611/gcal_event_description_subbullets__gem.md` - **Snapshot Ref:** `file:explicit:df618bc0af9db5702db4e0dc` - **Status:** Complete, registered, and finalized.
